body:
Lepton horizontal tabs gained a larger top gap in Floorp 12.17.0: the same vendor stylesheet sets `--tab-block-margin: 2px`, but Gecko 154 changed the native `.tab-background` consumer to `--tab-margin-block`, leaving it at 4px. Forward the existing Lepton value to the new name for horizontal Lepton padding only. Vertical native spacing and explicit `!important` theme overrides remain authoritative; touch density keeps its 4px value.

Related: #2670 / [KAN-95](https://floorp-projects.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-95). This fixes the measured Lepton regression, not every aspect of the original Windows 10/Fluerial report. Fluerial remained 4px in all three tested releases and is unchanged.

Validation:
- Unmodified signed Windows releases 12.16.4 (Gecko153/20260725075208), 12.17.0 (154/20260820063022), and 12.21.1 (159.0.1/20261103153232): 48 native headless chrome states across four designs, normal/maximized windows and two titlebar preferences. Lepton background gap 2→4→4px; original/current product trees unchanged, normal exit0.
- Current-product diagnostic stylesheet at the **production DOM-style origin**: 24 baseline +24 candidate states across four designs, horizontal/vertical and three densities, plus one retraction. Only Lepton horizontal normal/compact margins changed 4→2px; retraction restored4px. This is a CSS diagnostic, not a source-generated full-package validation. An earlier AGENT-sheet probe used the wrong origin and did not repair the margin; it is retained as an invalid candidate-equivalence trial.
- Two new colocated tests run inside actual Floorp chrome: both fail with unchanged base CSS (2 vs4px and custom11 vs4px), both pass with candidate CSS. They cover density, native vertical exclusion and explicit theme precedence. Both test sessions exit0 with all68 product files unchanged.
- Type check, lint and test-file formatting pass. [Standard CI42123057521](https://github.com/Floorp-Projects/Floorp/actions/runs/42123057521) and [source-generated Windows package42123152394](https://github.com/Floorp-Projects/Floorp/actions/runs/42123152394) are running; full-package acceptance remains pending.

Limits: Windows11 headless at DPR1, not original Windows10, physical input/GPU or native OS titlebar qualification. `elementFromPoint` checks are DOM hit-testing, not OS clicks. No native/runtime change, vendor modification or blanket removal of tab spacing. No merge/release/Done requested.

[KAN-95]: https://floorp-projects.atlassian.net/browse/KAN-95
